Wrapper and inner stable IDs are one definition with a required equality constraint. Repeated same-kind alias is not a second object; duplicate distinct definitions or cross-kind reuse refuse. Owner kind and source node variant determine reference target kinds.

Identity slots and reference slots must match the rederived complete role traversal exactly, including nullable references, array positions, Image phase/site/operator references, covariance parameter references, table/raw resource bindings, sourceEntryOrder and both native layer references. Unknown caller slots cannot confer authority.

Preserve semantic source strings and labels even when byte-equal to retired runtime IDs; only typed reference locations participate in renaming. Source record ordinals and external atom labels remain source facts.

Restore exact source scientific values/raw observations independently of derived native display projection. Unknown/high-dimensional entities remain source-only; no fabricated SG/FS capability. Recompute derived digests/caches from restored typed state under current pinned rules, retaining captured identities only as provenance.

Enumerate actual active fields/tables/scene links separately from the archive. All expected objects, kinds, owners, dimensions, axis/basis/units and every numeric bit/value must match independently registered source expectations before completeLoaded/Saved. Valid archive with absent active Field remains E_REOPEN_COVERAGE.

For ordinary later reopen reconstruct required-object expectations independently from saved typed source/qualified native references, not from objects the loader happened to return. Startup with an empty old cache must be equivalent.
